Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Latin4

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Latin4
public class Latin4 extends Object
Latin 4-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_LATIN4 section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x03.
